There is several ways to get introduce with investment. You can either buy stocks, bonds, and other financial instruments. However, all depends on your belief, your risk profile, and your investment horizon. One of the common investment strategy that ally all these aspects is portfolio investment. Why portfolio investment? Because it not only about picking the right asset, but also to diversify them by combining wisely them in a portfolio in order to mitigate the risk why maximizing the return. It is for this reason that the eponymous Markowitz model was developed. 
The purpose of this article is to introduce the Markowitz model and its application in portfolio selection.

Firt of all, the markowitz model only comes after selecting the universe of assets in which the investor is interested in. This choice will depend on the investor's belief. Once the universe of assets is selected, we are interested in how to combine them in a portfolio. In other words, we are interested in the weights of each asset in the portfolio. 
To formalize this problem, we thus need to define some parameters. Let's denote by \(n\) the number of assets in the universe. We will denote by $S_t^i$ the price of asset \(i\) at time \(t\). Hence, given a certain wealth \(W\) to invest, the value of a portfolio constituted of all the assets in the universe at time \(t=0\) is given by:
$$
V_0 = \sum_{i=1}^{n} q_i S_0^i
$$
